study_design: Prospective NIH-AARP Diet and Health Study cohort analysis of African-American men
reason: The abstract analyzes incident prostate cancer overall and reports no high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or otherwise aggressive incident endpoint. The total analytic cohort size is not stated in the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Neither white nor processed meat intake was associated with prostate cancer, regardless of meat-cooking method.
estimate_classifications.reason: The processed-meat estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, not aggressive disease. The abstract explicitly evaluates processed meat in relation to prostate cancer without defining an aggressive subtype.
